# Draft:TYSHA STEWART

----
Tysha Stewart
Tysha Stewart is an American luxury event planner and executive producer known for planning and executing high-profile celebrity events, weddings, and VIP experiences in the United States. She is the founder and principal of Premier Events, a luxury event planning company with over 20 years of professional experience.
Stewart has received national media coverage for her work on celebrity weddings and milestone celebrations, and for her professional association with sports and entertainment figures. In addition to event production, she has also worked as a personal assistant and event planner for Deion Sanders, supporting high-visibility events and executive-level logistics.
Early Career and Background
Publicly available information regarding Stewart’s early life and education is limited. She began her career in the early 2000s, working in executive support and event coordination. Over time, her work expanded into large-scale luxury event planning, leading to the establishment of Premier Events.
Career
Premier Events
Tysha Stewart is the founder and lead planner of Premier Events, a luxury event planning and production firm specializing in:
Celebrity milestone celebrations
High-profile weddings
Private luxury events
Sports and entertainment–related VIP experiences
Her work is characterized by discretion, detailed logistics, and coordination of complex, high-security events.
Notable Clients and Events
Stewart has planned and produced events for prominent figures in entertainment, sports, and public life, including:
Rick Ross – 50th birthday celebration (“Another Iconic Year”), Miami
Shedeur Sanders – NFL Draft party
LaToya Luckett – Wedding celebration in Austin, Texas
Travis Hunter and Leanna Hunter – Wedding celebration in Jackson, Mississippi
Deion Sanders – Multiple personal and professional events, serving as event planner and executive support
Rick Ross’ 50th birthday celebration received national media coverage for its all-white luxury dinner event attended by prominent figures in the music industry, including DJ Khaled and French Montana.
LaToya Luckett’s wedding was also widely covered in national media, with Stewart credited as the wedding planner.
Executive and Event Work with Deion Sanders
In addition to her event planning work, Stewart served as a personal assistant to Deion Sanders, where her responsibilities included executive scheduling, travel coordination, and operational support. Media coverage has highlighted her trusted role within Sanders’ professional circle, including her involvement in event-related and facility projects connected to his coaching tenure.
Media Coverage
Stewart’s work has been featured in national and sports media outlets, including:
Essence — Coverage of LaToya Luckett’s wedding, crediting Stewart as the event planner
iHeartRadio — Reporting on Rick Ross’ 50th birthday celebration
EssentiallySports — Articles referencing Stewart’s professional role with Deion Sanders
HBCU Gameday — Coverage of Travis Hunter’s wedding
